state.crashBody: An unexpected error occurred. Your data is safe. Try again, and if it keeps happening, copy the support details and send them to us.

errors.INVALID_VALUE: That value isn't valid. Check it and try again.
errors.TEXT_TOO_LONG: That's longer than allowed. Please shorten it.
errors.USERNAME_INVALID: Use 3 to 32 letters or numbers, with no spaces.
errors.USERNAME_TAKEN: That username is already in use. Choose another one.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: That password is too short. Use at least 8 characters.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: That password is too long. The limit is 128 characters.
errors.PASSWORDS_DO_NOT_MATCH: The passwords don't match. Type them again.
errors.PIN_INVALID: The PIN must be 4 to 6 digits.
errors.PHONE_INVALID: That phone number isn't valid. Use digits only.
errors.TAX_NUMBER_INVALID: The tax registration number has 9 digits.
errors.ROLE_NAME_TAKEN: A role with this name already exists. Choose another name.
errors.RECOVERY_CODE_INVALID: That code isn't valid. It has 24 letters and digits. Check it and enter it again.
errors.BACKUP_PATH_INVALID: Choose a file with the .invbak extension.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details aren't valid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session expired to keep your data safe. Sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this. Ask the owner to grant it.
errors.FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN: This request was refused for security reasons. Restart the app.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That item no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
errors.CONFLICT: This couldn't be saved because it conflicts with related data.
errors.INTERNAL: An unexpected error occurred. Your data is safe. Try again.
errors.NETWORK: The data service can't be reached. Restart the app.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That username or password is incorrect. Check them and try again.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: This account is locked after failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account is disabled. Ask the owner to enable it.
errors.PIN_NOT_SET: This account has no quick PIN. Sign in with your password.
errors.ALREADY_ONBOARDED: The app is already set up. Sign in instead.
errors.NOT_ONBOARDED: The app hasn't been set up yet.
errors.CANNOT_DISABLE_SELF: You can't disable your own account. Ask another owner.
errors.LAST_OWNER: This is the last owner. Add another owner first.
errors.ROLE_IS_SYSTEM: This is a built-in role, so it can't be edited or deleted.
errors.ROLE_IN_USE: This role can't be deleted because {{count}} user(s) have it. Move them to another role first.
errors.BACKUP_FAILED: The backup couldn't be created. Check there's enough space and the location is writable.
errors.BACKUP_INVALID: This file isn't a valid backup, or it's damaged.
errors.BACKUP_TOO_NEW: This backup is from a newer version. Update the app, then try again.
errors.RESTORE_FAILED: The restore failed. Your current data wasn't changed.
errors.NAME_TAKEN: That name is already in use. Choose another one.
errors.SKU_TAKEN: That item code belongs to another item. Change it, or leave it empty to generate one.
errors.BARCODE_INVALID: That barcode isn't valid. Check the digits: the last one doesn't match.
errors.BARCODE_TAKEN: That barcode is registered to another item.
errors.BARCODE_DUPLICATED: That barcode is repeated. Each barcode can belong to one item only.
errors.PRICE_INVALID: That price isn't valid. Enter a number with up to 2 decimal places.
errors.FACTOR_INVALID: Enter how many units, as a number above zero.
errors.UNIT_NOT_FOUND: That unit isn't known. Add it first in Catalog setup.
errors.VARIANT_LABEL_REQUIRED: Enter a name that tells this variant apart.
errors.CATEGORY_CYCLE: A category can't be placed inside itself.
errors.REFERENCE_IN_USE: This can't be deleted because {{count}} item(s) use it. Move those items, or archive it instead.
errors.REFERENCE_IS_SYSTEM: This is a built-in entry, so it can't be renamed or deleted.
errors.IMPORT_FILE_INVALID: Choose an Excel .xlsx file or a .csv file.
errors.IMPORT_FILE_UNREADABLE: The file couldn't be read. Make sure it isn't open elsewhere and isn't damaged.
errors.IMPORT_COLUMNS_MISSING: The file is missing a column: {{columns}}. Use the ready-made template.
errors.IMPORT_TOO_MANY_ROWS: The file is over the limit ({{limit}}). Split it into smaller files.
errors.IMPORT_EMPTY: The file has no items in it.
errors.EXPORT_FAILED: The file couldn't be saved. Check the location is writable and the file isn't open.
errors.QUANTITY_INVALID: Enter a valid quantity above zero.
errors.QUANTITY_NOT_WHOLE: This unit doesn't allow fractions. Enter a whole number.
errors.LOT_REQUIRED: This item tracks batches. Enter the batch number.
errors.EXPIRY_REQUIRED: Enter the expiry date for this batch.
errors.LOT_EXPIRY_MISMATCH: This batch is recorded with a different expiry date. Check the batch number or date.
errors.LINE_DUPLICATED: This item is repeated in the document. Remove one of the lines.
errors.UNIT_CONVERSION_INVALID: This unit isn't set up for this item.
errors.SAME_WAREHOUSE: The receiving warehouse must differ from the source.
errors.STOCK_INSUFFICIENT: Not enough {{item}}: {{requested}} needed, {{available}} available. Check the quantity, or record the stock first.
errors.DOCUMENT_NOT_DRAFT: This document is posted and can't be edited. To correct it, void it and create a new one.
errors.DOCUMENT_NOT_POSTED: Only a posted document can be voided.
errors.DOCUMENT_EMPTY: Add at least one item before posting.
errors.SUPPLIER_NAME_TAKEN: A supplier with this name already exists. Pick another name or edit that supplier.
errors.SERIAL_COUNT_MISMATCH: The number of serials does not match the quantity. Enter one serial per piece.
errors.SERIAL_DUPLICATED: A serial is repeated in this document. Check the serials.
errors.SERIAL_TAKEN: One of these serials is already registered for this item. Check the serials.
errors.SERIAL_NOT_IN_STOCK: One of these serials is not in stock, so it can't be returned. Check the serials.
errors.RECEIPT_EXCEEDS_ORDER: This is more than what is left on the order. Lower the quantity, or record the extra on a separate invoice.
errors.PAID_EXCEEDS_TOTAL: The amount paid is more than the invoice total. Record the difference as a separate payment on the supplier's page.
errors.SUPPLIER_ARCHIVED: This supplier is archived. Restore them from their page first.
errors.ORDER_NOT_OPEN: This purchase order isn't open, so it can't be received or cancelled.
errors.SERIAL_ALREADY_SOLD: A piece from this invoice has already left stock, so it can't be voided. Record a return instead.
errors.PAYMENT_BELONGS_TO_PURCHASE: This payment was made with a purchase invoice. Void the invoice itself if it is wrong.
errors.PRICE_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN: You aren't allowed to change the price. Ask a manager, or use the listed price.
errors.DISCOUNT_FORBIDDEN: You aren't allowed to give a discount. Ask a manager.
errors.DISCOUNT_TOO_LARGE: The discount is more than what is being sold. Lower it.
errors.ITEM_NOT_PRICED: This item has no selling price. Set one on its page first.
errors.RETURN_EXCEEDS_SALE: This is more than what is left on the invoice. Check earlier returns.
errors.SERIAL_NOT_ON_SALE: One of these serials wasn't sold on this invoice, or has already come back. Check the serials.
errors.LOT_EXPIRED: This batch has expired, so it can't be sold. Pick another batch.
errors.CUSTOMER_ARCHIVED: This customer is archived. Restore them from their page first.
errors.PAYMENT_SHORT: The amount paid is less than the total. Add the rest, or put it on a customer's account.
errors.PAYMENT_OVER_TOTAL: Card, wallet and account amounts can't go over the total, because change is only given in cash.
errors.CREDIT_NEEDS_CUSTOMER: Selling on account needs a customer. Choose one first.
errors.CREDIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Over the credit limit: the balance would be {{owed}} and the limit is {{limit}}. Collect some of it, or raise the limit.
errors.SHIFT_NOT_OPEN: There is no open shift. Open one first.
errors.SHIFT_ALREADY_OPEN: A shift is already open. Close it before opening a new one.
errors.SHIFT_OTHER_USER: The open shift belongs to {{name}}. Close it first, because the drawer is in their name.
errors.SALE_HAS_RETURNS: This invoice has a return on it, so it can't be voided. Void the return first.
errors.SALE_NOT_RETURNABLE: This document can't be returned, because it is voided or is itself a return.
errors.PRINT_FAILED: Printing failed. Check the printer is connected and chosen in settings. The sale itself is recorded.
errors.LICENSE_TOKEN_INVALID: That activation code isn't valid. Copy all of it and try again.
errors.LICENSE_OTHER_DEVICE: This code was made for another device. Ask for one using this device's number.
errors.LICENSE_READ_ONLY: The app is read-only because the license isn't active. You can still view, export and back up. Renew it to carry on working.
errors.LICENSE_SERIAL_INVALID: That serial isn't valid. Check it and try again.
errors.LICENSE_TAKEN: This serial is active on another device. Contact us to move it here.
errors.LICENSE_STOPPED: This license has been stopped. Contact us.
errors.LICENSE_RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.LICENSE_SERVER_UNREACHABLE: The license server can't be reached. Check the internet, or use an activation code.
errors.DISK_FULL: The disk is full, so nothing was saved. Free up some space and try again.
errors.AI_NOT_ENABLED: The AI add-on isn't on for this license.
errors.AI_CONSENT_REQUIRED: The shop owner needs to agree first, in Settings.
errors.AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: This month's AI allowance is used up. The rest of the app works as usual.
errors.AI_OFFLINE: This needs internet. The rest of the app works as usual.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI service isn't available right now. Try again shortly.
errors.AI_UNREADABLE: This file couldn't be read. Try a clearer picture.

start.title: Your first day
steps: Import your items from an Excel file on the Items page, or add them one by one.
Record your opening stock with an adjustment on the Stock page.
Add your staff and give each a role on the Users page.
Choose your printer and paper in Settings.

sell.title: Selling
steps: Open a shift at the till and enter the cash in the drawer.
Scan a barcode or search by name, then press F12 to pay.
A return starts from the sale itself, on the Sales page.
Close the shift at the end of the day and enter the counted cash. Any difference is shown.

stock.title: Stock
steps: Every change in quantity is a numbered document. A balance is never edited directly.
Batches go out soonest-expiring first, automatically.
A count compares what you counted with the balance and settles the difference when posted.

purchases.title: Purchases and suppliers
steps: Create a purchase order, then receive all or part of it.
Record the supplier’s invoice. The stock and what you owe both go up.
Record what you pay on the supplier’s page and review the statement there.

reports.title: Reports
steps: Every report reads the documents directly, so it always matches the movements.
Choose a period, then export to Excel or PDF.
Seeing profit is a separate permission from seeing reports.

backup.title: Backups
steps: The app takes an automatic backup on this PC every day.
Copy one to a USB drive regularly. A failed PC takes everything on it.
The recovery code is the only way to open a backup on another PC, so keep it away from this one.

license.title: Your license
steps: The app works offline and checks the license whenever internet is available.
After a license ends there are 7 days of grace, then the app becomes read-only.
In read-only mode your data, reports, exports and backups all stay available.

ai.title: AI
ai.notEnabled: An optional add-on that isn't on for this license. The rest of the app works without it, and nothing leaves your PC.
ai.consentIntro: This feature sends some data off this PC, so it needs your agreement first.
ai.consentSent: What leaves: only the invoice file you choose to read.
ai.consentKept: The file isn't stored on the app's server. Only the number of requests and their cost are recorded.
ai.consentProcessor: Reading is done by Google Gemini. Google keeps requests for a limited time to detect abuse, may process them outside Egypt, and doesn't use them to improve its products.
ai.consentCustomers: Your customers' names and numbers never leave this PC.
